image_description: A close-up shot of a black hockey puck resting on the white, curved boards of an ice hockey rink. The puck is positioned in the lower-left quadrant. The background shows the glossy, slightly textured surface of the rink boards with some reflections and a small red light reflection near the bottom.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object clearly exhibits the standard aspect ratio of a hockey puck, appearing as a short, wide cylinder.
The geometry is consistent with a solid disk; no internal structures or hollows are visible.
The surface is highly reflective and glossy, showing strong specular highlights, rather than the expected matte finish of vulcanized rubber.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Acoustic properties cannot be verified from a static image.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy vulcanized rubber construction with substantial weight for its compact size.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The puck has a high-gloss, wet-looking sheen that is inconsistent with dry vulcanized rubber. It resembles polished plastic or obsidian more than sports equipment.
The characteristic circumferential ridges/grooves are completely absent, resulting in an unnaturally smooth side profile.
The curvature of the rink board behind the puck seems slightly inconsistent with the perspective of the ice surface in the foreground, appearing somewhat flattened.
